name: Q3 Executive Compensation Adjustment Drill
subject: ACTION REQUIRED: Review Your 2026-2027 Compensation Tier
previewText: Please verify your employee ID and direct deposit confirmation within 48 hours...
body:
Dear Employee,

As part of our annual compensation adjustments, our records indicate your compensation tier has been updated for Q3 2026. Please log in to the employee portal via the link below to verify your tax withholdings and direct deposit confirmation before Friday 5:00 PM.

Failure to review by the deadline will defer your next payroll disbursement.
objective: Evaluate staff vigilance against urgency-driven HR payroll credential harvesting lures.
redFlags: Manufactured urgency regarding payroll withholding deferral

name: Mandatory IT Endpoint Compliance Patch
scenario: Fake IT Security Alert with Direct SSO Link
subject: CRITICAL: Urgent CrowdStrike Falcon Certificate Update Required
previewText: Your endpoint compliance certificate will expire in 2 hours...
body:
Hi Colleague,

Our automated security monitoring system detected that your workstation EDR certificate has desynchronized from the corporate master server. If not re-authenticated within 2 hours, your VPN and network access will be temporarily locked out.

Please authenticate your Microsoft 365 identity below to push the certificate update silently.
objective: Test developer and technical staff susceptibility to technical jargon and immediate lockout fear.
redFlags: Legitimate EDR agent updates are managed silently without manual user SSO inputs

name: Urgent Vendor Overdue Invoice #INV-9902
subject: OVERDUE NOTICE: Immediate Wire Transfer Required for Invoice #9902
previewText: Notice of pending account suspension for primary hosting servers...
body:
Attention Accounts Payable,

Invoice #9902 for $18,450.00 is now 14 days past due. If funds are not received via wire transfer within 24 hours, cloud database instances will be suspended.

Review the attached invoice PDF and updated banking details.
objective: Assess finance team protocols for out-of-band banking detail verification.
redFlags: Unverified bank routing modifications requested via plain email
High urgency threat of server suspension

name: CEO Offsite Confidential Inquiries
subject: Quick task — in meetings today
previewText: Are you at your desk right now? Need a quick discreet favor...
body:
Hi,

Are you at your desk right now? I am tied up in confidential investor discussions and my phone is on silent. I need you to handle an urgent confidential request for an upcoming client closing dinner. Let me know if you can assist right away.

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
CEO
objective: Train employees to recognize CEO impersonation via free webmail addresses.
redFlags: Sent from personal @gmail.com address rather than corporate domain
Request for secrecy and bypassing normal office phone contact
Pretexting setup for subsequent gift card or wire fraud

name: Shared Cloud Document Notification
subject: Elena Rostova shared a document '2027 Strategic Roadmap.docx' with you
previewText: Click here to open and collaborate on the document in OneDrive...
body:
Elena Rostova has invited you to view the document '2027 Strategic Roadmap.docx' hosted on Enterprise Document Share.

This link will remain active for 24 hours.
objective: Baseline simulation evaluating document sharing link inspection.
redFlags: Link targets third-party harvesting domain instead of corporate tenant SharePoint
No notification inside real Microsoft Teams or Outlook calendar
